name: Rossari Biotech Ltd
title: Rossari Biotech Ltd - 543213 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 record revenue (Rs 684.9 cr, +18% YoY) but EBITDA margin fell to 11.3% and management guided FY27 margins flat at 12–13%, with capex cut to Rs 50–75 cr from Rs 192 cr plan.

utilisation.quote: Utilization levels for ethoxylation are practically 90% to 100%, whatever maximum we can do.

capex.peers_comment: As Reliance revised its capacity expansion plans, we also moderated our capex spend.
capex.quote: we internally have decided to rephase our earlier CAPEX spend, which was announced in April of Rs. 192 crore across Rossari, Unitop and Tristar.

triggers.label: Capex rephased Rs 192 cr → Rs 50–75 cr FY27
triggers.quote: The CAPEX plan for this year would be I think anything between Rs. 50 crore to Rs. 75 crore

triggers.label: Raw material pass-through from April
triggers.quote: from this month onwards, we have been able to pass through all our high purchase raw materials into adding margins

triggers.label: Ethoxylation utilisation 90–100%
triggers.quote: Utilization levels for ethoxylation are practically 90% to 100%, whatever maximum we can do.

triggers.label: EBITDA margin held at 12–13% for FY27
triggers.quote: the EBITDA margins will remain at these current levels between 12% to 13%

guidance.quote: we will continue to do at least minimum similar kind of growth that we have done in this year
the EBITDA margins will remain at these current levels between 12% to 13%
anything between Rs. 50 crore to Rs. 75 crore, that is the plan
The target is to actually get debt free in the next 18 months, but the time will tell.
In FY27, we should look at breakeven or even profitability

red_flags.label: Institutional/B2C losses widening, capex cut and asset sales
red_flags.quote: losses have continued to moderate throu gh the second half of the year

red_flags.label: Promoter stake-sale rumours denied
red_flags.quote: There is nothing on the plan at this moment.

evasions.quote: No, we would not like to hazard any number.
This data we do not put forth, and we do not talk about it.
We would not be able to share so much of detail
